mapper.select: SELECT d.doc_id, d.uploader_user_id, u.name AS uploader_name, d.meeting_id, d.original_name, d.filepath, d.mime_type, d.size, d.sha256, d.original_lang, d.storage_key, d.uploaded_at, d.use_context_rag FROM ${table} d LEFT JOIN tl_users u ON u.user_id = d.uploader_user_id WHERE d.doc_id = #{docId} AND d.uploader_user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${table} (uploader_user_id, meeting_id, original_name, filepath, mime_type, size, sha256, original_lang, storage_key, uploaded_at,use_context_rag) VALUES (#{userId}, #{meetingId}, #{originalName}, #{filepath}, #{mimeType}, #{size}, #{sha256}, #{originalLang}, #{storageKey}, NOW() , #{useContextRag})
